summary: Returns the range once both are known to be the same size, or throws.
description: The assertion form of `isGridRangeSameDimensions`. The default message states both sizes, so a mismatched copy says how far off it was.

params.message: The message of the exception. A default stating both sizes is used when omitted.

throws.InvalidGridRangeException: the two ranges are not the same size.

examples.title: Guarding a copy
